item.title: Director shares how travel restrictions are impacting Green River Festival lineup - Daily Hampshire Gazette
item.description: The Green River Festival has had to cancel two international acts due to travel restrictions imposed by the Trump administration, but the festival remains committed to presenting a diverse global lineup and has found replacements for the canceled acts.

item.title: Level services or deep cuts? Southampton to present multi-option override discussion on Thursday - Daily Hampshire Gazette
item.description: SOUTHAMPTON — Facing a $2.6 million deficit next year, officials are outlining three budget scenarios this spring: a full-service plan requiring an override, a smaller-override compromise, and a “catastrophic” plan with deep cuts.
